audit.summary: Theorems4.1 and4.6 fail under their general printed hypotheses. P4 andP5 are Major invalid derivations on the Kan and main Hurewicz proof paths with analytically supported repairs. P3 is a Minor coefficient-domain defect whose inspected application already uses the correct ambient system. No counterexample to the GM main theorem, normal Thom-Mather application, Kan conclusion or Hurewicz conclusion is asserted.

repair.content:
For CS sets require path-connected regular parts of U0,U1,U0 intersection U1.

Restrict to GM perversities (and no codim1 strata); then complementary perversity monotonicity gives nu*Dp<=Dp.

Take E on GpconeL and restrict it to GpL; common low skeleta give vanishing.

m=min_{i!=k}t_i; rho_i=t_i-m(i!=k),rho_k=t_k+ell*m. Missing-face inverse t_i=y_i+y_k/ell,t_k=0; other faces fixed.

Add all opens off centralstratum to tipproduct neighborhoods; intersections have Pk by smaller depth or conelemma; finite unions and directedcompact-chain limits complete proof.
